summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SMART Small Cap ETF (SSCP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund provides exposure to small-cap US companies. The actively managed fund uses a multi-step process that identifies securities exhibiting strong momentum and revenue growth. SSCP was launched on May 11, 2026 and is issued by Smart.

holdings.infoBox: SSCP is an equity ETF with a total of 34 individual holdings. The top holdings are Ooma, Inc. stock at 4.97%, Paysign at 4.92%, Himalaya Shipping at 4.88%, Smith & Wesson Brands at 4.84%, and Kaiser Aluminum at 4.80%.
